mapper.select: SELECT t_game_type_game.game_type_id AS gameTypeId, t_game_config.content AS content, t_game_type_game.game_name AS name, t_game_type.is_show AS Isshow, t_game_type.game_type AS gameType FROM t_game_config, t_game_type, t_game_type_game WHERE t_game_config.level = t_game_type_game.game_level AND t_game_type.id = t_game_type_game.game_type_id AND agent_id = #{agentId}

SELECT g.game_type_id AS gameTypeId, c.content, g.game_name AS name, t.is_show AS Isshow, t.game_type AS gameType FROM t_game_type_game g JOIN t_game_type t ON t.id = g.game_type_id JOIN t_game_config c ON c.id = ( SELECT MIN(gc.id) FROM t_game_config gc WHERE gc.level = g.game_level ) WHERE g.id IN ( SELECT MIN(candidate.id) FROM t_game_type_game candidate JOIN t_game_config gc ON gc.level = candidate.game_level WHERE candidate.agent_id IN ( SELECT gp.default_agent FROM t_game_province gp JOIN t_province_agent pa ON pa.province_id = gp.province_id WHERE pa.agent_id = #{agentId} ) GROUP BY candidate.game_type_id ) ORDER BY g.game_type_id
